Potato_Late_Blight.recommended_action: Spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold @ 250g/100L water) or Mandipropamid (Revus @ 200ml/acre). Ensure lower leaf coverage.
Potato_Late_Blight.authority_citation: NARC Potato Program & Potato Research Institute Sahiwal Advisory 2024

Potato_Early_Blight.recommended_action: Spray Difenoconazole (Score @ 125ml/acre) or Azoxystrobin @ 100ml/acre. Maintain vigorous vine nutrition.

Tomato_Early_Blight.recommended_action: Spray Chlorothalonil 75 WP @ 500g/acre or Mancozeb 80 WP @ 600g/acre. Prune lower diseased foliage touching soil.
Tomato_Early_Blight.authority_citation: Punjab Agriculture Extension Department Tomato Manual 2024

Tomato_Late_Blight.recommended_action: Apply Metalaxyl + Mancozeb @ 250g/acre or Cymoxanil @ 300g/acre immediately during cool, foggy spells.

Wheat_Yellow_Rust.recommended_action: Spray Propiconazole (Tilt 250 EC @ 200ml/acre) or Tebuconazole @ 250ml/acre at first appearance.
